The series is produced by a South Korean production team and will be broadcast on TV5 and the streaming platform Viu. The program follows South Korean actor Ji Chang-wook and several Filipino celebrities as they manage a pop-up restaurant in South Korea.

The title of the show is derived from the Tagalog greeting "kumusta", which translates to "how are you?". The show centers on a cultural exchange between the Philippines and South Korea through culinary arts. The cast members temporarily operated a Filipino restaurant named "Kumusta Café" located in the Gangnam District of Seoul. During the production, the cast worked daily shifts ranging from 12 to 16 hours over a period of seven days. The menu featured traditional Filipino dishes such as inasal, kare-kare, sisig, and roasted pig known as lechon.

title: Deool Band 2
description: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

title: Ghabadkund
description: Ghabadkund is the first Marathi cinematic universe-a gripping blend of suspense, action adventure. In a mysterious village, a string of unexplained events pulls an outsider into a hidden world of secrets tied to the legend of Ghabadkund

title: Married Alive
description: Single dad Mack & his soon-to-be-married son Tony may not survive their off-road camping trip when their Jeep overturns, trapping Tony underneath. With a storm coming, Mack has to find help to save his son from drowning.

title: Mareechika
description: Follows Venkata Laxmi, a village girl who claims Sanju has been murdered, and introduces Mareechika, a US-returned woman, into his life, leading to shifting relationships and a murder investigation.

title: Housepainter
description: A paroled house painter in Venice Beach's life brutally falls apart over the course of a few bad days.

title: INBITE
description: A girl watches Tv at night when she notices her snacks have disappeared. The house is dark but she can hear that she is not alone in it..

title: The Djinn's Curse 2
description: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

title: Confined
description: The story of a gang put together by a crime boss in order to pull off a heist. It all seems to be going well, until it’s not. The crew gets broken up after the heist due to external circumstances, and upon reuniting, there is undeniable tension between the men. They are confined to a hideout in a remote location, waiting to hear from the boss. But the question is - how long will they be able to trust each other?

title: Roid
description: A solitary middle aged man marries a madwoman and builds a house on a vacant plot of land far from the village. However, his wife’s madness becomes a calamity in his tranquil life.

title: Secert in the Box
description: Remake and update on Au Yeung Ping Keung’s murder mystery after his death

title: Doctor Bahu
description: With compassion in her heart and courage in her decision. She heals lives in the hospital and fights expectations at home. Starring Kubra Khan and Shuja Asad. Dr. Bahu, where dreams meet responsibility.

title: Blood vs Duty
description: In the world of crime and injustice, dangerous missions force those on opposite sides of the law to choose between protecting family and doing their duty.

title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
description: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

title: Monay
description: Mona, a desperate woman fighting to save the bakery she shares with her younger sister, Monina. When a wealthy businessman offers financial help in exchange for a risky arrangement, Mona must risk love, family, and herself.

title: Chardikala
description: The film follows story of Bibi Bimal Kaur a mother and a wife who is falsely implicated in a major incident, leading to her being abandoned by society. She finds refuge in Punjab, where she moves from being a victim to a leader.

title: Ananthan Kaadu
description: This is a tale, which almost became a true story. It unfolds in the late Eighties and early Nineties, when the country was going through a dark phase both politically and socially a time when turmoil was writ all over the political scape of the nation.

title: Ember
description: An elderly couple is trapped in their village near Kyiv as it falls under Russian occupation. When a fire destroys their home, they are forced to seek refuge with neighbors and find a way out.

title: Yene Semay
description: A Film By Kirubel Seyoum

title: Sweden Porno: Blonde Animal
description: The woman gets entangled with joy and euphoria. Romantic porn that depicts the reality of a swamping couple swapping in Scandinavia! Along with Norway, which is called the country of the night, on the Scandinavian peninsula, Sweden is known worldwide as a free sex developed country, now with the advent of the sex liberation era

title: Nooru Sami
description: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

title: Alliance
description: Lin Shuang  once a brilliant student at a top-tier university  ended up being a full-time mom. But she was betrayed and had to return to the workforce to fight for custody of her child. In her disheveled state  she met Gu Xu  her ex-classmate and now a talent from overseas. She confronted the challenges with Jiang Xi and Gu Xu  transforming into a professional from a homemaker  and fell in love with Gu Xu. Lin Shuang and Jiang Xi experienced personal growth  ushering in a new life of their own.

title: The Doomies
description: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world  they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery  they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

title: Deuce Purgatory
description: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

title: The Belladonna
description: Haunted by visions of her late mother, a burlesque dancer’s paranoia deepens when she becomes convinced a fellow performer is plotting to steal her crown as Queen of the Belladonna Club.

title: Sol Summer
description: A woman, healing from her family's wounds, recounts her past to a Deity before the world's coming judgment.

title: Beneath the Night
description: A metro driver with colorful hair is unexpectedly chosen as the face of a public transport advertising campaign, blurring the lines between the visible and hidden.

title: Ninja Wars - BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
description: Rikka Isurugi (Chihiro Yamamoto), head of the Fox Clan, is investigating the "White Lotus," a mysterious cult suspected of plotting a rebellion against the Shogunate. During her mission, she encounters Okyo (Kanon Miyahara), a Fuma Ninja dispatched by the Shogun. Their paths converge as they face a formidable common enemy: the Iga Ninja clan, led by Hattori Hanzo (Kane Kosugi), who harbors a deep vengeance against the Tokugawa family. A three-way conflict between the Fox Clan, Fuma Ninja, and Iga Ninja is about to begin.

title: MASTERCLASS
description: In a time without space, a group of actors desperately try to stage a play under the supervision of a computer.

title: Chaali Din
description: Chaali Din is an adaption of best selling punjabi novel of the same name. This gripping story by Gurpreet Dhugga delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships over a transformative 40-day journey. The book explores themes of love, loss, redemption, and self-discovery through vivid storytelling and well-drawn characters. With its gripping narrative and profound insights, this work captures the essence of life’s challenges and triumphs.

title: Circo Zarathustra
description: Drawing on the vast body of Nietzsche’s work and weaving together his writings and his thought, Leonardo Petrillo has created a remarkable work that analyses the paradoxical, at times extreme and contradictory thinking of modernity’s most controversial philosopher.

title: Babymetal Live at Intuit Dome
description: Celebrating their 15th anniversary, and as part of their 2025/2026 world tour, BABYMETAL made history as the first Japanese group to hold a one-man live show and sell out said show at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles!

title: Momacu
description: On a freezing winter night in rural Haryana, three men steal an ATM and hide it in a tube well room. Overnight, mistrust and chaos shatter their desperate plan.

title: The Legend Hunters
description: The story follows the team as they try to raid a tomb made by master tomb raiders. It is set partially in Russia and will involve scenes at Catherine Palace in St. Petersburg.

title: Strangers in the Mountain
description: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: Phool Pishi O Edward
description: In a zamindar household, a watchful aunt becomes the quiet witness to a mystery that slowly exposes injustice.

title: Everybody, Sing!
description: A Philippine musical game show touted as the "first community singing game show" where no one will be left empty-handed. Wherein features several community groups  which consists of 50 individuals  where they are asked to complete a line of a song in order for them to receive cash prizes  and a chance to share a winning jackpot of ₱1 000 000.

title: Killing Castro
description: Centered on true events when Cuban revolution leader Fidel Castro visited New York City and stayed in Harlem in 1960.

title: The Street Photographer
description: Matthijs is a street photographer in Amsterdam, aiming to succeed and grow within his profession. A new client gives him a unique photography assignment: create a photo that captures the spirit of art in Amsterdam.  Matthijs travels the city in search of the best photo, ultimately learning not only what he considers the essence of true art, but also how he can become a better artist himself.

title: Original Night
description: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

title: MIN(D/E)
description: In the ruins of post-disaster West Java, a child escapes from a rehabilitation center and tries to find meaning and well-being in life.

title: A New Dawn
description: Keitaro lives in a fireworks factory that is about to be shut down. He is determined to unravel the mystery of the Shuhari, a mythical firework created by his father before he disappeared without a trace – and launch it before the factory closes.

title: Aai Saiba!
description: When kind-hearted but clumsy Tiatr dreamer Joe finally gets his big break at the 100th show, a kidnapping gone wrong plunges him into comic chaos forcing him to save the performance and his only chance to shine.

title: Pee Nak 5
description: A year after the deadly battle that finally subdued the vengeful ghost of Nak Tinn, the cycle of vengeance returns once again.

title: Zombeid
description: A couple Stuck in a down park on Chand Raat with zombies, must keep them contained to save Eid.

title: Choked
description: Shakona doesn't always want to be treated so nicely... sometimes she wants to feel like the world does: chaotic. Yet she can't get her devoted and loving boyfriend Eddie to meet her needs, so she goes to where all good decisions are made: a hookup app. Just as it seems like Shakona is finally letting go, she has the chance to take power into her own hands.

title: Loose ends
description: Danny and Mike, two gang members sent to kill a rat, find their mission thrown into disarray when Danny gets second thoughts moments before the hit.

title: Sitting
description: Four friends gather for drinks. As the night deepens, reason quietly slips out of the door, and drunken madness takes its seat at the head of the table.

title: Langkah
description: Laffet, a village boy who wants to move to the city, is in conflict with his father who strongly rejects his decision. Mamak tried to calm him down, but Laffet still left. In the city he works, but missing his family continues to haunt him. When he finally returned home, he found only an empty house and signs of loss that he could not prevent

title: Primal Darkness
description: Cole Harrington, the host of a popular outdoor series, sets out to track down the predator responsible for a series of cattle attacks in rural Nevada. The mystery deepens when he uncovers footage depicting the final moments of two missing university employees.

title: Parimala & Co
description: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

title: Madonna Non Grata
description: A thriller surrounding an undiagnosed schizophrenic with multiple personality disorder.

title: Landship
description: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Catsitting
description: A teen documenting his catsitting job finds that there's more in this house than he thinks...

title: Argiope
description: After what seemed like a promising first date, Julián wakes up tied to a chair in a dark room, bleeding and alone. With no idea how he got there, he desperately searches for a way to escape before it’s too late. A broken bone offers a slim chance at freedom, but a single mistake alerts his captor.

title: Deaf
description: The School for the Deaf at the Alabama Institute is organized around a theory of total communication i.e. the use of signs and finger spelling in conjunction with speech, hearing aids, lip reading, gestures and the written word. The film shows sequences dealing with various aspects of this comprehensive training such as teaching students and parents to sign; speech therapy; psychological counseling; regular academic courses; vocational training; disciplinary problems; parents visits; sports and recreational activity; training in living and working independently; and developing skills in home and money management.

title: Shake, Rattle & Roll Evil Origins
description: In 1775 during the Spanish colonial period in the Philippines, nuns attempts to survive the night after an unknown evil was set free in their cloister. Meanwhile in 2025, a group of friends attend a Halloween masquerade ball which was attacked by a serial killer. Fast forward to the future in 2050, a post-apocalytic Philippines is ruled by the aswang.

title: New Group
description: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

title: The Margins
description: A nighttime journey into the abyss, where medieval marginalia perform an everlasting bureaucratic ritual in which the ticket becomes a fragile sacrifice.

title: Summer's Camera
description: After her father passed away, Summer stopped taking photos. One day, she falls for Yeonwoo, the school's soccer star, and takes her picture with her late father's camera. When she develops the film, she finds mysterious photos of her father's high school lover. In these photos, Summer uncovers a secret about her father. Will she be able to pursue her first love and uncover her father's hidden truth?

title: Sugar Beach
description: A brilliant yet haunted valedictorian seeks refuge in a passionate throuple, but when their intoxicating world unravels, she must confront her past before it destroys her.

title: No Good Men
description: 2021, Afghanistan right before the Taliban’s return. Naru, the only camerawoman at Kabul’s main TV station, struggles to keep custody of her three-year-old son after leaving her serial cheater husband. Convinced no good men exist in her country, Naru is caught off guard when Qodrat, Kabul TV’s most important journalist, gives her a career opportunity. As the two crisscross the city reporting on its last days of freedom, sparks fly and Naru starts to doubt herself: could there actually be a good man out there?

title: Sanctus House
description: Four college students venture to a storied haunted house over night. The goal is simple, obtain research for a paper they are writing on urban myths and legends. A caretaker, played by Richard Grieco, greets them and offers to share the tale of the home's tragic beginnings. As events unfold, the group starts to understand there's more to the stories.

title: Branches of a Fig Tree
description: In a peaceful world recovering from catastrophe, a spirited runaway meets a magnetic community leader. As they fall in love, they discover truths about connection, the world, and their pasts- and realise they might be more connected than they thought.

title: You Are the Film
description: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

title: Detective McMan in the LABYRINTH OF LIES
description: When movie director Howard Morrison is murdered, polar opposite detectives Geoffrey McMan and Drake Blake must solve the case. Can they find who murdered Howard Morrison before more people die, or will they themselves die trying?

title: Tokyo Burst: Crime City
description: Rookie detective Aiba, a native of Tokyo's red-light district (with all the attitude and methods that entails), must team up with Cho, a counterpart from Seoul with equally questionable practices, to track down a dangerous criminal spreading terror across Japan, Korea, and the Philippines. While the relationship between the two investigators is frosty at first, they'll have to learn to work together quickly in the face of such a formidable adversary.

title: Black Box (Flight 298)
description: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

title: Effi o Blaenau
description: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

title: Budaixi
description: Wayang Potehi is a cultural heritage that has long been part of Indonesia's diversity, yet it remains little known in Surabaya. Through regular performances, preservation efforts, and the sharing of knowledge, dalang Sukar Mudjiono and fellow practitioners work to ensure this traditional art form survives for future generations.

title: Riakoi First Love
description: Twenty-seven-year-old Sawako Okazaki works for an event-planning company and finds purpose in supporting her favorite idol, Kaisei Komaki. When her employer signs him and staff compete for the chance to manage his events, Sawako throws herself into the opportunity. Her admiration gradually becomes real love, but a woman claiming to be Kaisei’s girlfriend and harassment inside and outside the company shake her confidence. As Kaisei begins to trust her, he suddenly disappears. Sawako must overcome the setbacks and discover whether her devotion can become a genuine romance.

title: Thiefish
description: A thief and a fisherman work together to steal a fish spirit being used as an energy source in order to return it to the ocean.

title: She's the He!
description: Before graduation, Ethan and Alex pose as trans women in a last ditch effort to quell gay rumors. It's all a joke until Ethan realizes: she really is trans. The two must reckon with their changing friendship, coming out, and coming-of-age.

title: Heart Set on Her
description: Mia and Emma decide to take the next step toward marriage, only to find their first challenge lies in bringing their families together. Amid complicated traditions, dowry preparations, and the chaos of wedding planning, they face arguments, doubts, and uncertainty about the future. As expectations from both sides begin to weigh on them, they start to question what happiness truly means—and whether marriage is really the answer.

title: Les Heures Mortes
description: Camel, 20 years old, stifled by the violence of his social condition and his factory job, one day unintentionally triggers a global shutdown with a single sentence he utters. He nevertheless meets a girl his own age, unlike any other, who will offer him answers and a day outside of time that he will be forced to forget forever.

title: Flag Day
description: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

title: 谢霆锋2026进化演唱会北京鸟巢站
O Horizon
description: Abby, a brilliant, young neuroscientist who has recently lost her father, drowns her grief by spending her days working with a monkey named Dorey. Abby meets a programmer, Sam, who has created a technology that reconnects Abby with her beloved father. Her relationship with her digitized dad then forces her to re-examine everything from her romantic relationships to her life’s work.

title: Cheer Dad
description: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

title: Our Land
description: Through organised 'mass trespass' events, the Right to Roam movement sets out to increase public access to nature, but finds itself in conflict with England's landowners.

title: Pickleball
description: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

title: It’s All Good
description: Aaron, Vinny and Cooper are dead broke and ready to give up on their pursuit of becoming big shot filmmakers. Desperate to keep the dream alive, they turn to crowdfunding for their first feature film and raise $75,000 dollars. However, they are overtaken by greed and instead blow the money on frivolous luxuries. Now they must face the consequences, including some shady acquaintances interested in their fortune, and an onslaught of angry donors who have been deceived.

title: The Barrel
description: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

title: Avemmaria
description: Felice lives in two dark rooms of a crumbling building with his father Raffaele, recently laid off, his mother Antonietta, too young and worn down by grief, his grandmother Filomena, always dressed in black and filled with resentment, and three brothers, with another on the way. In that world of poverty and violence, a boy like him can either be crushed or cling to his dreams. His imagination is his refuge, but in Pianura there's no room for fantasy - being poor and a dreamer is a fault. Yet his teacher, Giulia, recognizes his singing talent and tries to offer him new horizons. When Felice sees Neil Armstrong's footprint in his textbook, he realizes he too might leave Pianura and reach the moon.

title: Andy Lau “TODAY…is the Day” Hong Kong Concert Tour 2024/25
description: This concert was professionally filmed for the Hong Kong show, as part of Andy Lau's most recent tour across 72 shows from 5th July 2024 to 10th January 2025

title: Anna VS the Kids
description: Anna, a friendly but reclusive fortysomething, harbors an unusual phobia: she’s terrified of children. When she reconnects with Alexandre, her ex-boyfriend she never stopped loving, she thinks she’s finally found happiness… until she discovers he has two kids. When circumstances force her to care for them alone, a panicked Anna reluctantly agrees. Between ridiculous rules and absurd situations, this forced living arrangement might just change everything… for worse, but also for better.

title: A House Most Haunted
description: When a man clears out his childhood home to put on the market, he and his friend discover his parents' past seance records and hypnosis journals - awakening something that should have stayed buried.

title: Monkey Graveyard
description: Phorn, a middle-aged orangutan caretaker working in a military zoo, confronts an unprecedented tragedy as the orangutan in his care has committed suicide.

title: My Wife Cries
description: A normal working day on a construction site. Thomas, a 40-year-old crane operator, receives a call from his wife asking him to pick her up from the hospital. He finds her crying.

title: A Castle of Our Own
description: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

title: Another World
description: What would drive someone to drop everything and move into a city park in lower Manhattan? In the fall of 2011 hundreds of people did just that as a public protest against corporate greed and with the hope of creating an alternative society. Occupy Wall Street started as an under attended protest that quickly caught fire and capturing international headlines, the imaginations and hearts of people across the globe. Almost overnight the movement transformed the national dialog about economic inequality and corporate corruption. The slogan 'We are the 99 percent' instantly became part of the national lexicon. This documentary is an intimate portrait of several key players who helped create the movement and their wild ride through the rise and fall of Occupy Wall Street.

title: Double Occupancy
description: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

title: The Founder5 II: Unfinished Business
description: Grander, bolder and sharper, the Founder5 returns to the stage with other talented comedians for more standup, improv and sketch comedy.

title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
description: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...

title: Lali: Live at River Plate 2026
description: Lali, one of the leading voices of Latin pop, takes over the legendary River Plate Stadium for the grand finale of her "No Vayas a Atender Cuando el Demonio Llama" tour. Filmed during the second of two sold-out nights, this electrifying concert showcases her unmatched stage presence, powerful performances, and the deep bond she shares with thousands of fans. A historic celebration of music, passion, and the evolution of an artist at the peak of her career.

title: Project Baby
description: The story follows Sandy, a 30-something advertising executive who, fearing her biological clock is ticking, launches "Project Baby"—a step-by-step mission to conceive a child on her own terms with a no-strings-attached donor. She selects Migo, a sensitive artist, but quickly realizes that meticulous plans can't account for human emotion.

title: Kata Hati
description: When celebrity actress Ayra Natasha's glamorous life unravels in one humiliating night - a red carpet disaster, a cheating boyfriend, and a viral disappearance, she finds herself in the back seat of a stranger's car, ugly-crying into a box of tissues. Her unlikely rescuer is Imran Firdaus, an e-hailing driver with nowhere particular to be and no reason to care… except that he does.  What begins as a forced arrangement - Imran hired as Ayra's personal driver to contain a tabloid storm slowly becomes the one real thing in both their lives. But Ayra belongs to a carefully constructed world of sponsors, film contracts, and a power couple narrative that her manager-sister Maya cannot afford to let fall apart.  Kata Hati is a Malay-language romantic comedy about the words we perform for the world, and the ones we only dare say to the ones we love.

title: Spirits Talk
description: A grieving woman’s reality and memories begin to blur as her adoptive mother, Mother Nikki, reaches out to her from the spirit realm. She must speak to her mother one last time—or risk losing the ability to love herself and others.

title: The Leader
description: In 1997, thirty-nine members of the American cult known as "Heaven's Gate" committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on American soil. This is their story.

title: Taming The Beast
description: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

title: Daydream
description: A young adult recounts childhood memories involving his 6th grade teacher and the lessons she taught, particularly her unconventional assignment: to daydream.

title: Lifeline
description: Kai (Leehom Wang) awakens on his Shanghai houseboat––alone. His girlfriend Emma (Olivia Munn) has suddenly disappeared, leaving behind the one thing that could lead to her whereabouts: her smartphone.  Deeply disturbed, Kai seeks to uncover where she went, with whom she's connected, and what she took with her. Is Emma really who she says she is? Or is there something more sinister at play?

title: Mr. Shota's Last Business Trip
description: Shota, a machinist who dedicated his life to his work, prepares for his final business trip to Korea before retiring. Meanwhile, Daesung heads to Japan to win back his ex-girlfriend. The two men happen to meet at a ramen shop on the first day of their journeys. When Shota's resignation letter and Daesung's love letter are swapped, an unexpected story begins.

title: Deewana
description: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

title: French Girls
description: A young woman enters the uniquely absurd world of modelling in this Sydney microbudget marvel. The debut feature of Hyun Lee.  Mia is drifting through life working on construction sites when she’s scouted by a Sydney model agent. Suddenly, she’s making more money than ever while working less – something her boyfriend loves to point out. Mia quietly observes this strange new world of modelling with deep uncertainty. Is this really the life she wants? With one curious turn after another, she finds herself in trouble with the law.

title: The VelociPastor 2
description: The perfect movie DOES exist! Doug and Carol travel to the port city of Milan, where they have to solve a series of murders committed by a masked slasher at an Italian Fertility Festival. And Soviet Spies. INTERPOL’s there, too.

title: Blood Lines
description: Whilst embarking on a lesbian relationship with the new girl in town, a Métis woman’s life is rocked to the core when her estranged mother returns.

title: Far from Maine
description: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

title: Susana and Elvira: No Plan B
description: Susana and Elvira, two former best friends, reunite after two years apart to organize the celebrity wedding of the year.

title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
description: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

title: A Mosquito in the Ear
description: Andrew and Daniela travel to Goa, India, to meet their newly adopted 4-year-old daughter, Sarvari, and bring her back to the US. However, their world begins to crumble when Sarvari refuses to leave the orphanage that she calls home behind. The couple’s attempts to welcome their child into her new family and travel back with her prove to be a chaotic challenge that not only tests their patience but also profoundly reshapes their ideas of family, parenthood, and their relationship as a couple.

title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
description: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
description: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.

title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
description: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

title: Return of the Jungle
description: Nine year old Mihir and his friends are faced with the daunting task of outwitting the biggest, meanest bully in school, Rahul Malhotra. To help them ride through this impossible journey, they turn to Thatha and his fantastic tales of inspiration from the ancient Jungles of India. Together, they must build a ruthless dinosaur, fight a nerve- racking game of cricket and travel all the way to Rajasthan, to rediscover the power of friendship, compassion and determination.

title: The Blind Girl and an Elephant
description: Three girls try to flee their village to escape the superstitions and fanatic hostility surrounding them. Only the blind girl makes it out, finding herself face-to-face with an elephant.

title: Jinsei
description: Our hero (voiced by rapper ACE COOL), called by a different name in each chapter of his life, becomes a J-pop idol, an outcast, a leader, and an oracle in this hundred-year chronicle spanning the past, present, and future. Through a chance encounter with a transfer student, he trains to become an idol, starting his search for self-identity and a journey toward greatness beyond superstardom. Written, directed, edited and entirely hand-drawn by newcomer Ryuya Suzuki over eighteen months, JINSEI (meaning “life” in Japanese) is an anime tour-de-force that announces Suzuki to the world as a bold new talent in independent animation.

title: Something Romantic
description: A young couple in Sydney return home from a “very special” night out.

title: Treat Her Like a Lady
description: When single mother Sandra, full of unwavering energy, is evicted from her apartment by the Dutch government due to fraud, she convinces her daughters Harrie and Stella that their emergency shelter is a holiday hotel. Taking care of her children while being the main breadwinner seems impossible, but Sandra won't go down without a fight: with heroism and creativity, she gives her daughters the best summer of their lives.

title: Sgt. Frog
description: New Sgt. Frog movie to celebrate the series' 20th anniversary.

title: Forge
description: In Miami, siblings Raymond and Coco Zhang’s art forgery ring flourishes when they encounter a disgraced millionaire in need of their expertise. Meanwhile, FBI Art Crimes agent Emily Lee moves to Miami to investigate a series of mysterious paintings.

title: That Burning House
description: At Home of Happiness, a devoted social worker struggles to reform troubled youth while the institution falls into crisis. A bullied boy clings to his late mother’s teddy bear as his world collapses. A former resident, lured into a telecom scam, faces a moral dilemma that threatens his life. Across different paths, each must confront the scars of the past and decide whether to fall into darkness or fight for a way forward.

title: Midnight City
description: Dutch Lazarus is a detective who specializes in strange cases. When a new client walks into his office and stymies him at every turn, we begin to wonder what her game is, and if Dutch already knows a lot more more than she's telling.

title: Mil pedazos
description: Miguel (55), Isabel (45), and Emilia (9) go on vacation with their dog, Eve. Suddenly, an accident in the middle of the desert leaves the mother seriously injured. Miguel, trying to save Emilia, embarks on a personal journey with his daughter to find answers about what happened. Three months later, Isabel awakens from a coma and begins a personal, loving, and intuitive quest to rebuild her family.

title: Scent of a Spell
description: A young man saves a woman who is trying to commit suicide, gradually discovering more about her troubled past.

title: Melodrama
description: After her husband’s death, Sonia is forced to shrink her life, trading her sprawling family home for a cramped, unfamiliar apartment. In this state of displacement, her world is a quiet hum of grief and rigid routines, until she hears the rhythm of a neighboring construction site. There she meets Aimé, a Haitian worker whose presence awakens a dormant yet intense desire. Their connection is swift and tender, yet their romance exists in a crossfire.

title: The Curse Of Black Pond
description: A group of teenagers go to an old house on vacation with a big black pond, what they don't know is that a long time ago, a witch was drowned and killed there and now she's back for revenge, on those who live in her house.

title: Forastera
description: Cata will see her summer vacation disrupted by the absurd and sudden death of her grandmother, which only she witnesses. Her grief shifts when she casually turns to play pretend, transforming into the deceased. What begins with a game of dress-up will blur the lines of reality and family roles.

title: That Damned Thing
description: A coroner’s inquest into an inexplicable death reveals the presence of an enigmatic creature.

title: Bogatyrs
description: Ancient Rus. The hero Svyatogor defeated the evil Sorcerer who wanted to conquer Rus - to do this, he used magic to turn into a Dragon. Svyatogor hid three artifacts (the claw, eye, and vein of the Dragon) in the modern world so that evil would never return. But because of the schoolboy Vanya, the Sorcerer's beloved enters our time. She wants to find these artifacts, resurrect the Dragon, and bring her betrothed back to life. Together with two heroes from ancient Rus, Vanya must find the villain and prevent her from carrying out her plan.

title: Never After Dark
description: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

title: Borley Rectory: The Awakening
description: In 1900, young Reverend Henry Bull and his sister, Kitty, are tasked with taking over the duties of their family home in Essex, a majestic Victorian mansion built on the site of an old monastery. Unaware of the sinister forces that lurk within, the pair are soon confronted by terrifying paranormal activities that threaten their loved ones. Desperate to protect themselves from the demonic intrusion, they call upon the services of a trusted family friend to investigate the origins of the vengeful ghosts which haunt their property. But these are spirits who will not rest, and Borley Rectory is doomed to gain a chilling reputation, as the most haunted house in all of Britain.

title: Phera
description: Two men share a house and a past that no longer fits them. As city life pulls Palash forward and age holds his father Pannalal in place, an unexpected return forces them to confront their differences and the quiet truths they have avoided.

title: Meet Me in the Margins
description: A book editor secretly pens her own romance manuscript, only to find unexpected editorial notes from a mysterious critic in the margins. The film is a witty, heartwarming story about finding love between the lines.

title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
description: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt. Refusing to give up, Katie does everything in her power to make this proposal happen, until Dan calls it off. Katie must lean into Chef Carlos’ spontaneity to not only save the day and the proposal, and Carlos may just win Katie’s heart too!

title: The Boy with the Light Blue Eyes
description: A cursed blue-eyed boy seeks love in a remote mountain ruled by superstition.

title: What's the Story, Wishbone?
description: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.

title: Billions Club Live with Olivia Rodrigo: A Concert Film
description: Live from Barcelona, Olivia Rodrigo takes her top fans on an emotional ride through her biggest songs during a one-night-only Billions Club Live concert. From her Billions Club hits to her new single "drop dead," along with a few fan favorites, it all unravels in one unforgettable live performance.

title: Let's Go! Anpanman: Baikinman and Lulun
description: One day, Baikinman finds a picture book, hears a voice calling for help from inside the book, and is sucked into the book, where he meets the forest fairy Lulun. Lulun, who is too scared to muster up the courage, asks her to defeat the "Sucking Elephant" that is rampaging in the forest. Although Lulun is reluctant at first, she gains courage when she sees Baikinman standing up to Suitoruzo, but she is forced to struggle against Suitoruzo's strength. In a desperate situation, Baikinman tells Lulun to call Anpanman, but...

title: Dark Giant
description: Dark Giant is a Supernatural Horror and Psychological Family Drama. It Explores How Greed, Guilt, and Generational Trauma Can Manifest as a Literal Curse, Destroying a Family From the Inside Out

title: Judge Michael - Rise of the Law
description: A new enemy has risen on mega city one, his name is Voss Kane " The Ripper " bringing chaos to the streets, now a new judge has emerged from the hall of justice teached by Dredd himself, to uphold the law and bring justice to the streets.

title: The Boy at the Edge of the World
description: Omul lives with his family on a remote island in the Fire Archipelago. During a beach trip, a storm sweeps Omul and his younger sister Kimi into the sea, where Omul witnesses a mysterious creature threatening Kimi’s soul.  Rescued by a whale, the siblings survive, but Kimi is left in a coma. Omul’s ability to talk to animals becomes crucial as he and his brother – who blames him for the accident – set out to find Sadumea, the mythical figure behind Kimi’s torment.  With their dog Tela, they embark on a dangerous expedition deep into the island to save Kimi…

title: The Dead Place
description: Troubled high school senior Isaac [Veliu] is plagued by visions of the dead. This causes friction in his family and makes him an outcast at school. His only friend Katharine [Graves] is obsessed with the paranormal and tries desperately to help him, but a ‘New Kid’ [Thornton] pushes him to give in to the demon trying to burrow its way inside him [Oberst]. As he is consumed by the evil feeding off the dead souls that haunt him, Katharine is the only one that stands between Isaac and his darker impulses. To satisfy the bloodlust of the demon that dwells within him.

title: Gugu's World
description: Gugu, a black boy living with his grandmother, experiences memories and revelations when the old city where she lived returns.

title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
description: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.

title: Kamu Harus Mati
description: Meta has been haunted by hallucinations since the death of her boyfriend. She feels terrorized by spirits, but her two best friends assume she's mentally ill, straining their relationship. As the terror intensifies and threatens her friends as well, Meta sets out to uncover the truth behind the events, even as she faces doubts about whether they're real or just hallucinations.

title: Under the Roof
description: After the death of his wife, an unstable father traps his adult son in a warped imitation of childhood. When the son finally attempts to escape, he learns that his father is terminally ill, and must decide whether to stay or leave.

title: Beneath the moon's shadow
description: One night, a mysterious series of murders occurs, and all victims are connected to "Kantakwee," a famous young actor. Later, "Lieutenant Thara," a tough female police officer, finds the body of "Natcha," a lawyer and her sworn enemy, lying in a pool of blood, murdered by the killer. Thara miraculously saves Natcha's life, but when Natcha recovers, she has lost almost all of her memory. Natcha becomes a key witness that Thara must protect 24/7. However, Natcha's amnesia makes Thara wonder if she is truly a victim or the killer... As they live together to uncover the truth, their closeness gradually transforms into a bond. But danger lurks in their relationship every minute, as the serial killer relentlessly hunts Natcha! As Natcha's memories slowly return, she draws closer to death. Can her former rival become her lover?

title: Tod meiner Jugend
description: A janitor with a loving wife and a devoted son leads a seemingly quiet, orderly life. One day, the boy asks his father an inconspicuous but profound question: “Dad, why are there no photos of you at my age?” Driven by a restlessness that can no longer be suppressed, the man returns to the place of his childhood: a children's home he has avoided for decades.

title: Paikar
description: An Iranian expat journeys back to his homeland, where he must face his domineering father and grapple with complex emotions about family ties, cultural identity, and his place in the world.

title: Pilgrims
description: Children in "The Village" go on a pilgrimage when they come of age. Daisy wonders why some of the pilgrims do not return. Daisy heads to "The Origin", a term used by the village people to refer to Earth, to find the missing pilgrims and discover the secrets of her village.

title: Welcome to Dolly's House
description: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

title: Sinsin and the Mouse
description: A young Japanese woman, who is reeling from the death of her much loved mother, decides to take a trip to Taiwanese capital Taipei to try to alleviate her loss. While there, an encounter with a young man sees the pair strike up a tentative friendship that could help her come to terms with the death.

title: Turncoat
description: A psychotic mastermind holds a group of interconnected strangers captive in a manipulative game with deadly consequences. Young and old, sinners and saints — everyone's guilty of something, but no one wants to pay the price.

title: RADWIMPS 20th Anniversary Live Tour
description: RADWIMPS celebrates 20 years since their major debut with this concert film, captured during their 17-show nationwide anniversary tour.

title: Nuclear Boy
description: The lonely 17-year-old outcast Aike craves attention and finds it online where he conducts dangerous chemistry experiments. Hoping to pull Aike out of his internet bubble, his mother, a hardworking nurse, sends him to the scouts to make real friends. When that fails, Aike feels rejected and hurt. To prove himself to the world, he begins his biggest experiment yet: he secretly builds a nuclear breeder reactor in his mother's shed, encouraged by a growing group of internet followers.

title: Night Terror
description: A woman battles lifelong sleep paralysis while living alone. As nightly episodes worsen her mental state, paranormal investigators suggest her condition may have supernatural origins.

title: I'm Gonna Kill You
description: In the distant future, inside an ‘all gay colony’, Cal and Spector, two paired lovers, fighting an internal battle – where remaining colony members ultimately pay the price of their twisted games.

title: The Catcher
description: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds.

title: The Blistering Blundering West
description: A bumbling, lovestruck cowboy stumbles through the western frontier, overcoming a series of comical obstacles in the hopes of making it on time for a date with the potential love of his life.

title: The Real Housewives van het Zuiden
description: A reality series that follows some of the most upper class women from the south of the Netherlands as they enjoy their lavish and luxury lifestyle.

title: Detached
description: Flor and his best friend Otis have always done everything together, but when a conversation reveals that their bond means different things to each of them, Flor is forced to confront a friendship he thought was unbreakable.

title: Trikala: Script of God
description: Trikala is a heroic story, one of the many mysteries hidden in Indian Sanatana Dharma.When darkness descends on the world, the light comes to save it, trikala is one of the Illuminator..

title: Veronica's Secret
description: A girl's disappearance spirals into unraveling a dark past and its secrets.

title: God of Mischief
description: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.

title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
description: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

title: Playing POTUS
description: Explores the uniquely American tradition of presidential parody, a bold art form that has transformed our perceptions of real-world presidents and politicians for the past 60 years. These iconic impressions have an outsized and lasting impact on American politics that has gone completely unexamined... until now.

title: The Great Skull
description: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

title: Pig That Survived Foot-and-Mouth Disease
description: A pig wanting to be a human is ready to give it his all, whatever the cost. A human wanting to be an animal is ready to give up everything.

title: Adrenal
description: CHAI Ya-hui returned to Taiwan after getting married in Japan. Since her husband committed suicide, she lived alone with her daughter Xiao-xiao. They were chased by gangsters. One day, Xiao-xiao and her classmate Ya-hoo were kidnapped, Ya-hui asked the police for help but was troubled, so she decided to save her daughter herself. The kidnappers use high-tech methods to torture her and Xiao-xiao, and unravel mysteries related to past dismemberments, organ trafficking, and historical trauma. As clues are intertwined, Ya-hui discovers the key to solving the case, and finally reveals the truth behind the obsession and trauma, and brings an unexpected ending.

title: No Hard Feelings
description: Down-on-his-luck ride-hailing driver Li Song eases his frustrations via an obscure podcast, held back from new romance by an embarrassing chronic ailment. Yin, pretending to be a Korean customer service agent at a health-supplement firm, drudges through client calls to save for an apartment. A follow-up phone call draws these two lonely urban strangers together behind lies. As reality and delusion crumble, they are forced to confront life and their true selves.

title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
description: This documentary uncovers one of the most consequential and little-known stories in modern football history and highlights the pivotal moment that helped shape Lionel Messi’s international future and altered the trajectory of global football.

title: Iván & Hadoum
description: Iván (33), a trans man, and Hadoum (30), a Spanish-Moroccan woman, fall in love at the industrial greenhouse they work in. While facing the opposition from their families and co-workers, Iván realizes he doesn’t need to be the man he is expected to be.

title: Midnight Mart
description: The series centers around the atmospheric, intimate late-night interactions between two young women inside a 24-hour convenience store.

title: Let’s Chat
description: One night while isolated and alone a boy rediscovers the importance of human connection through an AI platform called ‘Let’s Chat’.

title: Sith Athara Histhan
description: The story follows a group of interconnected characters who live together but feel deeply isolated from one another. It highlights how a lack of true communication, hidden secrets, and busy everyday routines build invisible walls between loved ones. As these secrets come to light, the characters must choose whether to break down their walls, face their vulnerabilities, and talk to each other, or let the growing silence permanently ruin their relationships.

title: L'amor fuggente
description: Fil and Mia are a close-knit couple and have lived together for years, although very different in character and attitudes: eclectic up-and-coming filmmaker he, methodical math professor she. Their routine is broken by an argument that culminates in an unexpected marriage proposal from Mia and Fil's subsequent elopement. This event triggers a set of stories that weave into a single narrative involving relatives and friends of the couple. Lives and loves at all ages will collide and intermingle only to end in a rousing surprise ending.

title: Plata: The Price of Risk
description: Plata: The Price of Risk — a documentary about how former Tinkoff Bank executives built a new bank in Mexico from the ground up. Oleg Tinkov, along with managers, developers, and product people from Russia — people who could have stayed home and lived comfortably. Instead, they left and bet everything on an impossible idea. How it turned out — watch the film.

title: Palang Tod
description: Palang Tod is an erotic web series which tells a separate story in each episode.

title: RoboGobo
description: The story of five adorable pets without a home. A kid inventor named Jax adopts them and gives them super-powered robo-suits.

title: The Vampire Lestat: After Dark
description: Dive deeper into the world of The Vampire Lestat with this new series that takes fans behind the scenes of each episode with members of the cast and creative team. Hosted by writer and podcaster Lizzie Bassett.

title: The Masked Singer: South Africa
description: Celebrity contestants compete in singing competitions, all while under complete disguse. The panelists must make their identity guesses with the help of clues and voices. Each night, the least popular Masked Singer is eliminated and must reveal their identity until there is just one winner.

title: Resort
description: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Khelaghor
description: A rich girl gets accidentally married to an uneducated vagabond living in a slum. in the marriage demanding countless adjustments, will love find a chance?

title: Devil's Kiss
description: Three childhood friends from a small town arrive in Tokyo, only to be consumed by "devilish" obsessions, from desire and debt to prostitution, drugs, sexual violence, and manipulative cults, pushing their dreams and friendship to the breaking point.

title: We Want Now
description: A man who protects the island and his woman, Soo-hee, live on a remote island that is nothing more than an uninhabited island. And Bok-soon, who lost her mind after being abandoned by the man she loved. This is an island where only three people live, even if they die. Then one day, a photographer who seems to be holding something secret comes to the island. However, the man who guards the island misunderstands the visitor and kills him because of it. Bok-soon, who loved the dead photographer, commits suicide upon seeing the photographer's death. A man who has gone mad after killing someone hears a story from Soo-hee, who lives with him, and only later finds out all the secrets...

title: Vengeance
description: A man tracks down the five outlaws who murdered his brother, all the while being shadowed by a mysterious Pinkerton detective.

title: M4M: Motive for Murder
description: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

title: HK 80's
description: This sitcom  series premiered in 1981 and changed its name every year  from "Hong Kong 81" to "Hong Kong 86." It was eventually replaced by a new sitcom called "City Stories." A total of 1330 episodes were produced  making it the second-longest-running series in Hong Kong  after "Come Home Love: Lo and Behold".  Each episode of this series is inspired by current social issues  with early storylines often satirizing society's flaws. The characters  such as "Chen Ji " "Mrs. Shun " "Uncle Mao " "Jue Wu Yin " "Miss Su " "A Wei " and "Ah Kang " mostly hail from the grassroots  leaving a lasting impression on the audience. For example  "Mrs. Shun " portrayed by Lydia Shum  later became a term to describe uneducated women who follow trends blindly. "Chen Ji " played by Lawrence Ng  is a stockbroker who loves to show off his wealth  and his behavior typified that of many Hong Kongers  becoming a byword for the city's nouveau riche.

title: Tony Awards
description: The Antoinette Perry Award for Excellence in Theatre  more commonly known as a Tony Award  recognizes achievement in live Broadway theatre. The awards are presented by the American Theatre Wing and The Broadway League at an annual ceremony in New York City. The awards are given for Broadway productions and performances  and an award is given for regional theatre.

title: Knot
description: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
description: Meet Sasaki, an overworked, middle-aged office worker. His days are marked only by the passing of more unrewarding corporate drudgery. Smoking helps take the edge off, but other than that, the only bright spot of his day is when he goes to the nearby supermarket and sees Yamada's smiling face. So, one evening after yet another exhausting day, he heads to the supermarket to find he missed Yamada's shift. Dejected, he decides to go find a smoking area but discovers there isn’t one to be found. Just as he’s about to leave, a girl in a biker jacket named Tayama asks him to join her at a secret smoking area!

title: Sweet Tasks
description: Taking look on the day-to-day work schedule of literary and art workers as the starting point, it uses the three stages of meeting, observation, and dialogue to demonstrate professionalism, moral character, and positive values. To promote the fighting spirit and creative spirit of professionals from all walks of life in a general way.

title: Chachi No.1
description: Harsh has come to visit his aunt at the village. Upon coming here  he notices that his aunt is not satisfied with his uncle physically  so his infatuation gets the better of him  as he starts getting closer to his aunt.

title: Fast Forever
description: The eleventh and final installment in The Fast Saga. Plot TBA.

title: Downtown no Gaki no Tsukai ya Arahende!!
description: A Japanese variety show hosted by popular Japanese owarai duo  Downtown  with comedian Hōsei Tsukitei (formerly known as Hōsei Yamasaki) and owarai duo Cocorico co-hosting.

title: Junior
description: Feature documentary exploring the world of junior hockey and its relentless competitiveness. Portrait larger than life where young people of barely 16 years old already play their future.

title: Ask Yarası
description: When Pars discovers his biological father is alive, he leaves his poor life in Adana to join a wealthy Istanbul family. Forced into an arranged marriage with Asya, he struggles to forget his first love, testing whether old wounds can truly heal.

title: Girl
description: Muriel moves from a small village to the big city of Brussels, hoping to start an independent life working as a museum guide. She rents a room from Laura, who has a room to spare now that her mother is in hospital. Laura is a vital and candid woman who has a child-wish but leads a very chaotic life. Meanwhile, Muriel's mother has a hard time accepting that her daughter leads a life of her own now, and she also faces some changes at the factory where she works. The movie follows the interconnected lifes of these three women of three different generations, who all face different problems.

title: We Can't Leave
description: What starts as a routine audition for a no-name indie horror flick quickly turns deadly when a group of actors find themselves trapped inside a building with no way out. They're hunted by masked killers who know every inch of the building.

title: Evil Dead Burn
description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
description: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: Iskole
description: To escape a forced marriage to a wealthy businessman, a dedicated teacher leaves her city life behind for a transfer to a remote rural village. There, she discovers a gifted young dancer and vows to nurture her talent. When a corrupt politician threatens to close down the underfunded village school, she joins forces with passionate fellow teachers and a kind-hearted local entrepreneur. Together, they rally the community to save the school, while she fights to protect mistreated village children and resist her family's relentless pressure to return home.

title: Anali
description: Entire Story takes place over a single night. It revolves around Jansi and her 8yr old child, who gets trapped between third world war tensions and dangereous men Lal Chetta, Khan Bhai & Ranga Reddy. These men far more dangerous than wild animals. The Note film thrillingly portraits by how Jansi uses her intelligence to escape and bring everything to an end.

title: Jana Nayagan
description: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
description: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his homeworld and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of an all-powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

title: Brave
description: Cult director Richard Stanley brings Marillion's music to the screen in the 50-minute BRAVE. A teenager believed to be suicidal is discovered wandering near the Severn Bridge. Suffering from severe memory loss, she seeks information about the mysterious events that led to her condition. This work of fiction was inspired from the true story of an amnesiac woman found at the bridge.

title: Snow White
description: The life of 20-year-old Nico from upper class Zurich is all party, sex and drugs when she meets Paco, the front man of a rap band. She finds herself drawn to his independent, creative and profound way of life, so different from her own. With naiveté and infinite self-confidence, she tries to adopt his lifestyle - without anticipating the consequences.

title: From the Ashes
description: Jailed for her husband's crime, a woman discovers that her only way out is to solve riddles from her mysterious past.

title: Kenatha Kanom
description: Desperate to find water, residents of a parched village start digging a new well, but what they find is not water but a dinosaur fossil.

title: Lingam
description: Framed for a crime he didn't commit, a kabaddi hero gets pushed into a world he never wanted and ultimately becomes a feared name.

title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal
description: Each week five restaurant chefs from a different city compete against each other - while the restaurant is running and with an à la carte order! The winner receives 5,000 euros and the “Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal” award!

title: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
description: When a carefree orphan and a runaway minister's daughter marry on impulse, their love is tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies — from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. Together, they uncover hidden truths and prove that love can survive even the darkest threats.

title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2
description: A mismatched pair, with a storyline involving a wrestler and a vibrant girl, combining romance, comedy, and drama.

title: Justice League
description: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne and Diana Prince assemble a team of metahumans consisting of Barry Allen, Arthur Curry, and Victor Stone to face the catastrophic threat of Steppenwolf and the Parademons who are on the hunt for three Mother Boxes on Earth.

title: I Am a Plaything
description: Hyo-min, who became a prostitute by choice, undergoes sex training to serve clients under the supervision of Kyeong-seop, the manager of the establishment. She services countless men and even learns advanced techniques directly from Kyeong-mi, who works with her. Meanwhile, Kyeong-seop gradually opens his heart as he discovers the reason behind Hyo-min's decision to enter prostitution.

title: Maayavi
description: Following an unexpected housing arrangement, three individuals find their lives deeply entangled in a complex web of love and deception. What starts as a simple search for stability quickly tests family loyalty and personal morals as hidden motives surface. Balancing intense romantic tension with lighthearted comedy, the narrative highlights the heavy sacrifices made for love and the consequences of hidden truths.

title: Creation of the Gods III: Creation Under Heaven
description: Ji Fa unites the princes of the four directions to march into Chaoge. Yin Shou and Tong Tian Jiaozhu set up the 'Nine-bend Yellow River Formation' and the 'Zhu Xian Formation'. Yuan Shi Tianzun brings the twelve golden immortals down the mountain, and the war between the three realms of humans, immortals and demons is about to break out.

title: TXT's Parenting Diary
description: TXT, who deliver flawless performances on stage, transform into five rookie uncles for their childcare debut! From their first encounter with 14-month-old Yu Jun to the struggles of feeding, changing clothes, outings to the playground, and putting him down for a nap, nothing about this real-life parenting journey comes easy. Through their clumsy yet sincere efforts, the members reveal their unexpected goofy side and affectionate charm. Disarmed by the baby, the members' day blossoms into a childcare diary filled with laughter, relatability, and excitement. Watching these five uncles rely on one another as they grow through every unpredictable moment adds a whole new level of joy. Will TXT be able to navigate the chaos and create a special experience with Yu Jun?

title: Neo Chinpira 2: Zoom Goes the Bullet
description: In the sequel to 1990's classic Neo Chinpira, Junko (Sho Aikawa) attempts to take out Kazama and then goes on the run. However, he quickly begins to feel homesick, and returns home to find that almost everything has changed. Noriko is now a bar mama with a lavish lifestyle, Yumeko is nowhere to be found, and his boss (Toru Minegishi) seems to have sinister plans involving Junko and his uncle (Jo Shishido).

title: Shrek 5
description: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure.

title: Ten Count
description: Corporate secretary Shirotani suffers from obsessive-compulsive disorder. One day he meets Kurose, a therapist who offers to take him through a ten-step program to cure him of his compulsion. As the two go through each of the ten steps, Shirotani's attraction to his counselor grows.

title: Together
description: Five teenage girls with a shared secret get together for a weekend of "No Consequences." The sex, drugs and rock n'roll they intend pale in comparison to the more dangerous path they find themselves on.

title: Young Washington
description: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (and Proud of It)!
description: Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world from a rising demon king–but all she wants to do is become a perfect maid! Reincarnated in a story-based video game, Melody veers off the set story path, refusing to heed the call to action and instead using her powers to clean. Her new world becomes increasingly chaotic, and the story? Totally unhinged and unpredictable.

title: Bom Dia Brasil
description: This show features the main news in Brazil and the world in a magazine format  with commentary on politics  economy  sports and gastronomy.

title: Taarkata
description: A former police officer returns to his hometown to probe a puzzling death connected to his history.

title: AI Girl
description: One day, a package arrives at quirky introvert Gen's doorstop. When she opens the package, she discovers a truly human-like robot, beautiful like the girl of Gen's dreams. While trying to find a way to send the robot back, Gen accidentally hits a button that has the robot opening her eyes and coming to life. With the beautiful, flirtatious, playful and sexy robot by her side, Gen is completely swayed and decides to keep her, giving her the name Ai.

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
description: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

title: A Secret in Prague
description: In a world where love is rarely simple, two people find themselves drawn to each other despite the expectations and struggles surrounding them. As family ties, personal choices, and difficult circumstances test their bond, they must decide how far they are willing to go to protect what they feel.

title: Other People's Things
description: Vigo lives a life he hates. He spends all day slaving away at a warehouse, having to put up with impossible demands from his higher ups and colleagues he hates. When the workday is finally over, he has to pay the bills, deal with increasing debts and provide a somewhat normal life for his younger sister and his girlfriend, the relationship with which grows more strained and opressive as time goes on. Things change when he meets Marija, a high society college student, with whom he starts a whirlwind romance with, gaining a whole new world of possibilities in the process. But, as time goes on, his facade begins to slip away and Vigo is forced to get into increasingly deeper criminal waters to sustain his image.

title: Alpha
description: Two fierce female agents tackle dangerous missions in a thrilling world of espionage, as they navigate perilous situations, execute daring stunts, and face unexpected turns in this action-packed adventure.

title: Elle
description: Follow Elle Woods in high school as we learn about the life experiences that shaped her into the iconic young woman we came to know and love in the first Legally Blonde film.

title: Blazing Him
description: Zhou Jing'an, a wealthy heir concealing his passion for music, crosses paths with Li Xingyao, a guarded musician raised in an orphanage. Connecting through late-night masked music uploads and tender, hidden gestures, the two navigate past wounds to melt each other's defenses and embark on a journey of love and healing.

title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
description: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain - Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work with Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

title: TNA Xplosion
description: TNA Xplosion is a television program produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling  featuring both highlights from Impact Wrestling and exclusive taped matches. It is now produced only for international markets  no longer airing in the United States. It currently airs in Canada on The Fight Network  in Asia and the Middle East on ESPN Star Sports  the Arab World on MBC Action  and is available on Challenge in the UK. On March 14  2013 Impact Wrestling and Xplosion will be film permanently from the road .

title: Olivia
description: Olivia is a young girl who has everything. She really wants to be on the soccer team  but unfortunately her school is limited to female soccer players. Because her twin brother  Ruben  was away for some time  Olivia took advantage of this opportunity to go secretly to auditioning for the band to replace her brother  who looks identical to her  by disguising herself as a man. At school  Ruben was also known as a good football player. This is Olivia's chance to prove that women can play football too.

title: It's My Time
